fields.label: Section
fields.description: Section heading this field renders under (consecutive rows with the same section group together)

fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Profile Field
Bid Field
User Input
Signature
fields.description: Profile Field / Bid Field auto-fill; User Input renders a marked blank with guidance; Signature renders a signing block (stamped with the profile's signature image only in an explicitly signed pack)

fields.label: Source Field
fields.description: Tender Business Profile fieldname (Profile Field) or bid context key (Bid Field). The 'directors' profile field renders as a table

fields.label: Signature Role
fields.options:
Signatory
Witness 1
Witness 2
Commissioner of Oaths
fields.description: For Signature rows: who signs this slot. Signatory/witness slots stamp from the profile's uploaded images in a signed pack; Commissioner of Oaths slots ALWAYS render as marked blanks - a commissioner must sign in person

fields.label: Multiline
fields.description: Render the blank/value as a multi-line block instead of a single line

fields.label: Guidance
fields.description: Kill-note-derived completion guidance printed with the field
